author: lurch
quote: The worst GTA game I have ever played. Incredibly boring. Why would they release this trash?

author: lurch
quote: Awful game. Wave after wave of bullet sponge enemies run at you while your guns feel like pea shooters. Impossible to shove groups of zombies away from you making movement and escape impossible. Zombies come from all angles. Unable to remove weapon mods. Random gear system is annoying and the card system also feels like another big chore. Buy on a large sale only

author: lurch
quote: Good graphics. Everything else is awful. Hilariously bad and cringe storyline. Devs should be ashamed
game_title: The Last of Us Part II

author: lurch
quote: Bugs and an AWFUL save game mechanic ruin what would otherwise be a very solid and hardcore RPG. I just got a refund processed after about the fifth time I've had to backtrack over about 45 minutes of already completed gameplay due to bugs and not having a recent save.

author: lurch
quote: A really awful game. Even free it's overpriced as you waste electricity downloading this game. I played about 15 minutes before uninstalling as its total garbage. From the rancid combat system that has awful lag and the clunky movement to the commander or whatever bleating orders at you over your controllers speaker (even when I am wearing headphones to be quiet) this game is absolute pus.

author: lurch
quote: It's like somebody made a "paint by numbers" RPG that looks like it's covered in some sore of shiny goo. Played about 10 hours then got incredibly bored. Annoying characters, AWFUL combat and AI, MUH DIVERSITY, rancid controls etc. The last time I buy a game in this series. Just awful.

author: lurch
quote: Really enjoyed this game, found it to be very addictive. Would be very hard to play without a small group of friends along for backup though. Not sure about the direction the devs are trying to take this game in but at the moment its good.

author: lurch
quote: I've clocked about 40 hours in this game. It's a good shooter I suppose but technically and storyline wise the game is a huge mess. It could have been so much better but they need to ditch this old ass engine and get some better writers.

author: lurch
quote: This is the game that made me stop and say "never again" to buying early access. I can't believe I spent $70 on this game only for it to be discounted on steam (still in early access) a mere week later. A huge slap in the face by Uber. The game is terribly bland, unfocused, and boring. It is full of bugs, has little to no documentation and a joke of a tutorial. Uber did very well to hype this game up so much and laughed all the way to the bank releasing a very bad game in the process. The game is worth $10 at absolute best.

author: lurch
quote: A bad game at absolute best. I was bored from the first moment I started playing this game. The controls just feel sluggish and clumsy, the graphics are laughable and the story is a huge yawn. The whole game just feels like a sloppy mess.
